data.reply: Hi, thanks for reaching out and sorry for the trouble. Please check your company's email spam or junk folders first. You should also ensure your email domain's SPF and DKIM records are configured to allow emails from our sending domains as described in our 'Email Delivery Troubleshooting' guide. If this does not resolve the issue, please provide the specific email addresses of the affected users so we can investigate further. [T-4828] Let us know if that does not resolve it.
